title: DuplicationSignal
description: Duplication signals from clone-detection tools such as jscpd. Represents a single collection run with detected code clones and summary statistics.

source.description: Metadata about the tool that produced these duplication signals.

version.description: Version of the tool that produced the output.

statistics.description: Aggregate duplication statistics for the analysed scope.

totalLines.description: Total number of lines in all analysed sources.

totalTokens.description: Total number of tokens in all analysed sources.

totalSources.description: Total number of source files analysed.

duplicatedLines.description: Number of lines involved in at least one clone.

duplicatedTokens.description: Number of tokens involved in at least one clone.

clone.description: A single detected code clone between two file regions.

id.description: Unique identifier for this clone entry.

format.description: Language or format of the duplicated code (e.g. "javascript", "typescript").

tokenCount.description: Number of tokens in the duplicated fragment.

lineCount.description: Number of lines in the duplicated fragment.

fragment.description: Actual duplicated code text, if available.

firstFile.description: Location of the clone in the first file.

secondFile.description: Location of the clone in the second file.

fileLocation.description: A region within a source file, defined by line (and optionally column) ranges.

filePath.description: Path to the source file, relative to the repository root.

startLine.description: One-based start line of the region.

endLine.description: One-based end line of the region (inclusive).
